261-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
261-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1339-6823-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6823-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2292-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-2624-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-2624-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2590-4247-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2590-4247-5776.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

4089-4247-5011.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-3693-3899-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
2060-3693-3899-5544-6431.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Walking Ballista ability from step 3.
Repeat.

824-2034-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2034-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2034-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

553-4586-5957.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Kianne.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

4149-4599-4871-6019-7296.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-3334-5189-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-3334-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Lae'zel.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3490-6006-7075-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7075-7297.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

243-628-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

985-3713-5078-6006.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1077-2292-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-5571-6331--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-4365-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-4365-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

222-527-4359-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4359-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-4124-5954-6664-6751.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-2906-3689-6518.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
1020-2906-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

618-5147-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1251-2034-3372-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1251-2034-3372-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

465-618-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2645-3609.manaNeeded: {5} each odd-numbered turn, with {4} each even-numbered turn
74-2645-3609.notablePrerequisites: Locus of Enlightenment has at least one charge counter on it.
74-2645-3609.description:
Activate Locus of Enlightenment using Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying its activated ability.
Resolve both Locus of Enlightenment abilities from steps 7 and 8, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Locus of Enlightenment using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying its activated ability.
Resolve both Locus of Enlightenment abilities, untapping it.
Activate Locus of Enlightenment's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying its activated ability.
Resolve both Locus of Enlightenment abilities, causing you to get two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1753-2933-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

91-969-1365-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

275-2103-2707.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

195-349-1170-2493.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
195-349-1170-2493.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cerulean Wisps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Chain Stasis, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Cerulean Wisps by paying {U}, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Chain Stasis from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cerulean Wisps, untapping the mana-producing creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1173-2160-2239-3337.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} on your first turn, with {2}{R}{R} available on all subsequent turns
1173-2160-2239-3337.notablePrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
1173-2160-2239-3337.description:
Cast Final Fortune by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
The Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, returning Final Fortune from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat each turn.

381-2034-2452-4311.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravebane Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Gravebone Zombie is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard.
Cast Gravebane Zombie from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.
